_doc: Conditions on townsfolk and heroes (Systems/Conditions.cs), after the SRD 5.1 conditions they name (srd). Each is read off what the person is already going through, so nothing new is saved: exhausted from fatigue or hunger (the SRD's exhaustion also comes of going without food), frightened while raiders strike next to them (or in any break listed in fear), charmed while a foe's enchantment holds a councillor, inspired in an inspiration, sick while sickness holds their house (Sickness.Holds), wounded while a hero carries a lasting wound not yet mended or replaced by clockwork. edge is advantage (1) or disadvantage (-1) on the rolls named in on: checks (skill checks, contests) and saves (saving throws); advantage and disadvantage cancel, as in the SRD.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.text: Worn out or starving: disadvantage on checks until they sleep or eat.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.text: Raiders close by, or fear has hold of them: disadvantage on checks and saves.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.text: A foe's enchantment holds them: disadvantage on saves, and they vote as it wants.

conditions.name: Inspired
conditions.text: Something has lit a fire in them: advantage on checks while it lasts.

conditions.name: Sick
conditions.text: Sickness holds their house: disadvantage on checks until it passes.

conditions.name: Wounded
conditions.text: A lasting wound wears on them: disadvantage on saves until it is mended.
